title: Pyramid with 100 Agents
intro: BOOT runtime started · Pyramid with 100 Agents · log grouped by workflow chunk type

entries.action: The user requested a build. We have a PNG and need a usable blueprint.

sublines.tools: Send message to Designer: Convert the relevant PNG into a blueprint.

entries.action: Generated the coarse 3D structure and exported it into a Minecraft object.

sublines.tools: Tool call TRELLIS.2 -> ObjToSchematic: prepare source geometry.

entries.action: Converted the object into a buildable JSON blueprint.

sublines.results: Result: blueprint is ready for region splitting.

entries.action: The blueprint is ready. I need to split it into build regions for parallel work.

sublines.tools: Tool call Split Blueprint: divide the blueprint into Region A through Region E.

entries.action: Assigned the five regions to Foreman teams and prepared worker subplans.

sublines.results: Result: 5 foremen and 100 workers are ready to build.

entries.action: Received Region A and started assigning worker subplans.

sublines.tools: Tool call Assign Subplans: distribute region work to workers.

entries.action: Collected enough worker results in Region A. This repeated workflow can become Learned Region Placement.

sublines.notes: Worker-001 completed A-01 and Worker-002 completed A-02.
Workers are repeating Read Subplan -> Check Inventory -> Go To Region -> Place Blocks.

sublines.tools: Send message to ProjectManager: Please summarize this workflow as Learned Region Placement.

entries.action: Foreman-A reported a repeated placement workflow. I should turn it into a reusable skill.

sublines.skills: Tool call Create Skill: Create Learned Region Placement from Read Subplan -> Check Inventory -> Go To Region -> Place Blocks.

sublines.results: Result: Learned Region Placement is ready.

entries.action: Received subplan A-03 and Learned Region Placement. I can place region blocks with one skill call.

sublines.skills: Tool call Use Skill: Learned Region Placement with subplan A-03.

sublines.results: Result: blocks are placed and reported to Foreman-A.

entries.action: Region workers are continuing the build; no additional reusable skill has appeared in this video.

sublines.notes: Progress follows the red boxed markers in the video.

entries.action: All active regions have reported completion. The build now moves into final verification and cleanup.

sublines.tools: Tool call Verify Build: check whether the current build matches the blueprint.

entries.action: Final verification is complete and the build is accepted.

sublines.results: Done. Pyramid has been built and verified.
